# Release Decision

This record belongs to the maintainer. An Evaluation Result does not make this decision.

## Human decision

Record accept, reject, narrow, withdraw, or roll back, with the responsible maintainer and date.

## Evidence reviewed

Link the Case Snapshot, Project Revision, frozen Evaluation Definition, and Evaluation Result used in the decision.

## Accepted scope and trade-offs

State the environments, task family, interfaces, knowledge, or documentation covered by the decision and any accepted maintenance cost.

## Claims not established

List performance, correctness, compatibility, or generality claims that remain unsupported.

## Release, rejection, withdrawal, or rollback carrier

Link the actual tag, release, closed pull request, withdrawal notice, or revert. A merge alone is not a release.

## Private material

Confirm that private material was not admitted as public proof or published with the decision.
